**Add a card by typing it in.** On the Scan tab tap "Add a card manually", or tap "Add card" in the Collection tab. Type the card's name and its number, as printed ("125/197" is fine), and your server finds the card: its picture, set, rarity, type, hit points and artist fill in by themselves, and it tells you whether you already own it. Pick the condition, variant, language and quantity, then tap Add. The boxes clear so you can type the next card straight away. When the scanner can't match a photo, its panel has a "Type it in" button.

If your server's catalogue has no such card, "Create it by hand" makes one the way the website's "Create card manually" does (set, rarity, types, HP, artist, image link, share as template). A card made by hand has no market price.

**Prices after you add a card.** When a card that is new to your collection is added, scanned or typed in, the app asks your server to look up prices, then refreshes the Portfolio and Collection so the card is counted. This needs an admin account on the server, and there is a switch for it in Settings ("Look up prices after adding a new card").

This build has the same app ID as the last one, so it installs straight over it.
